name: FreshRSS
description: Feature-rich RSS aggregator: mobile API, fever/Google Reader compat, article scraping.
compose:
services:
  freshrss:
    image: freshrss/freshrss:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:80"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/var/www/FreshRSS/data
      - ./extensions:/var/www/FreshRSS/extensions
    environment:
      CRON_MIN: "13,43"
    restart: unless-stopped
